{{Current events|year=2018|month=04|day=4|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Shin Bet]] and the [[Israeli Defence Forces]] announce the arrests of eleven suspected members of the Palestinian [[Islamic Jihad]] terror group off the Gazan coast suspected of planning an attack on the [[Israeli Navy]]. [http://www.israelnationalnews.com/News/News.aspx/244021 (Israel National News)] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/shin-bet-idf-thwart-islamic-jihad-attack-on-navy-boats-off-gaza-coast/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[2018 Land Day incidents]]
**The death toll from last week's clashes at the [[Israel]]i-[[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]n border rises to 19. [https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/palestinians/.premium-tens-of-thousands-of-palestinians-prepare-for-second-weekend-protest-1.5975456 (''Haaretz'')]
**Protests enter a second week, with [[Hamas]] organisers directing participants to stay well back from the border fence to prevent further violence. [https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/palestinians/.premium-tens-of-thousands-of-palestinians-prepare-for-second-weekend-protest-1.5975456 (''Haaretz'')]
**The [[Palestinian Authority]] asks the [[United Nations]] to investigate. [http://www.jpost.com/Arab-Israeli-Conflict/gaza-news/Palestinians-tell-UN-Israel-adopted-shoot-to-kill-policy-in-Gaza-547850 (The Jerusalem Post)]
**Israeli [[human rights]] group [[B’Tselem]] launches a campaign calling on soldiers to refuse orders at the border. [https://972mag.com/btselem-to-israeli-soldiers-refuse-orders-to-shoot-gaza-protesters/134398/ (972)]
*[[Terrorism in the United Kingdom]]
**[[West Yorkshire Police|Police]] questioning two men suspected of plotting terror attacks in [[Dewsbury]], [[West Yorkshire]] are granted an extension until April 10 to detain the suspects. [http://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-leeds-43638551 (BBC)]
*[[Terrorism in Pakistan]]
**The parents of Ayşe Deniz Karacagil, killed in [[Raqqa]], [[Iraq]] after she joined the [[Kurdistan Workers' Party]], are acquitted of a terrorism propaganda charge for attending her funeral. [http://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/parents-of-girl-who-died-fighting-in-pkk-ranks-acquitted-of-terror-charges-129793 (Hurriyet Daily News)]
*[[Terrorism in Egypt]]
**The [[Sohag]] Criminal Court in [[Egypt]] sentences 35 alleged [[Muslim Brotherhood]] members to life imprisonment and imposes prison terms on 155 more. Seperately, a military court sentences four more to life imprisonment, imposes prison terms on two others, and acquits 13. [http://www.startribune.com/egypt-sentences-35-to-life-on-terror-charges/478738093/ (''The Star Tribune'')]
*[[Terrorism in Turkey]]
**Police across the nation arrest a total of 29 alleged coup participants on suspicion of terrorism. [https://aa.com.tr/en/turkey/turkey-police-arrest-29-feto-linked-terror-suspects/1107905 (Anadolu Agency)]
*Authorities in [[Ukraine]] announce the arrest of a suspected terrorist in connection with a 2017 [[Kiev]] attack that killed two and wounded three including MP [[Ihor Mosiychuk]]. [http://en.interfax.com.ua/news/general/496664.html (Interfax)]

;Business and economy
*[[High-speed rail in Europe]]
**The first ever direct train from [[London]] to [[Amsterdam]] departs from [[St Pancras railway station]]. The new [[Eurostar]] service takes an estimated three hours and 41 minutes. [https://www.independent.co.uk/travel/news-and-advice/eurostar-london-amsterdam-direct-train-live-latest-updates-st-pancras-service-launch-netherlands-a8287041.html (''The Independent'')]
*[[Jet Airways]] of [[India]] orders 75 [[Boeing]] [[B737|737 Max]] jets. [https://www.flightglobal.com/news/articles/jet-airways-finalises-follow-on-order-for-75-737-max-447280/ (Flight Global)]
*[[Bahrain]] says a recently-discovered offshore oilfield in its territorial waters contains 80 billion barrels of [[petroleum]]. [https://oilprice.com/Energy/Crude-Oil/Bahrain-Says-Giant-Discovery-Holds-80-Billion-Barrels-Of-Oil.html (OilPrice.com)]

;Disasters and accidents
*A fire at the Perseus shopping centre in western [[Moscow]] kills at least one person and injures at least six others. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/moscow-shopping-centre-fire-latest-updates-russia-persei-mall-evacuations-casualties-a8287926.html (''The Independent'')]
*A fire in a building housing the [[Portugal|Portuguese]], [[Tunisia]]n, [[Argentina|Argentinian]] and [[Belgium|Belgian]] embassies in [[Stockholm]], [[Sweden]] injures 14 people. A man is arrested on suspicion of arson. [https://www.thelocal.se/20180404/police-suspect-arson-after-fire-at-stockholm-embassy-building-injures-14 (''The Local'')]
*The port city of [[Balikpapan]], [[Borneo]], [[Indonesia]] declares a state of emergency in response to an ongoing oil spill fire off the coast. The spill and fire killed four fishermen and is releasing toxic fumes. The slick currently extends to around seven square miles and marine fauna including protected species are being affected. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/apr/04/emergency-declared-after-oil-spill-ignites-on-indonesian-island-of-borneo (The Guardian)]

;International relations
*[[Ukraine]] and [[Turkey]] sign an agreement improving aviation co-operation. [https://aa.com.tr/en/turkey/turkish-ukrainian-aviation-authorities-ink-deal/1108306 (Anadolu Agency)]
*[[China]] threatens tariffs of 25% on the import of 106 U.S. products, including [[soybean]]s and [[Boeing|Boeing aircraft]] in reaction to a previous U.S. threat of tariffs worth up to $50 billion. [http://www.dw.com/en/china-matches-uss-50-billion-tariff-threat/a-43245748 (''Deutsche Welle'')]
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**The leaders of [[Iran]], [[Turkey]] and [[Russia]] meet in [[Ankara]]. They declare their commitment to achieving a "lasting ceasefire" in [[Syria]]. [https://ahvalnews.com/ankara-summit/turkey-iran-and-russia-committed-lasting-ceasefire-ankara-summit (Ahval)]
*The [[Viacrucis del Migrante]] caravan of mostly Central American migrants is stopped by Mexican authorities. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-immigration-caravan/mexico-vets-and-disperses-central-american-migrant-caravan-idUSKCN1HA2D0 (Reuters)]
*[[Illegal immigration to the United States]] 
**U.S. President [[Donald Trump]] signs an order sending the [[National Guard of the United States|National Guard]] to patrol the [[Mexico–United States border]] in reponse to Congress's failure to pass tightened border security measures. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/live-white-house-briefing-april-4-2018-live-stream/ (CBS News)]
*At a summit in [[Baku]], [[India]] and [[Azerbaijan]] discuss cooperation in areas including counterterrorism, agriculture, infrastuctural development, [[women's rights]], and trade. [https://www.aninews.in/news/world/asia/india-azerbaijan-agree-for-global-action-on-terrorism201804042126070001/ (ANI News)]
*[[Russian interference in the 2016 United States elections]]
**Lawyers representing [[United States]] [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]] are told by [[FBI]] special counsel [[Robert Mueller]] the President is considered to be more than a witness but is not under criminal investigation. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/04/04/politics/donald-trump-robert-mueller/index.html (CNN)]

;Law and crime
*Police arrest five suspects over a firebombing of a bus in [[Limpopo]], [[South Africa]] that killed six people. [http://ewn.co.za/2018/04/04/5-arrested-for-limpopo-petrol-bomb-attack (Eyewitness News)]
*The Conseil National des Barreaux, which represents [[France|French]] lawyers, calls for nationwide action to protest proposed legal reforms by Justice Minister [[Nicole Belloubet]]. [https://www.lawgazette.co.uk/news/dead-justice-french-lawyers-plan-national-action/5065508.article (The Law Gazette)]
*[[Gender identity]], [[LGBT rights in the United States]]
**Voters in [[Alaska]]'s largest city, [[Anchorage, Alaska|Anchorage]], reject a proposed amendment to the city charter which would have restricted public restroom use by the gender appearing on the users birth certificate. [https://www.out.com/news-opinion/2018/4/04/anchorage-alaska-voters-defeat-anti-trans-bathroom-bill (Out Magazine)] [https://www.adn.com/alaska-news/2018/04/03/anchorage-voters-lean-toward-rejecting-proposition-1-regulating-restroom-and-locker-room-use/ (Anchorage Daily News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Italian general election, 2018]]
**Ahead of formal talks on the formation of a [[coalition government]] [[5 Star Movement|5Star Movement]] leader [[Luigi Di Maio]] states he is willing to enter government with the [[Democratic Party (Italy)|Democratic Party]] and [[League (Italy)|League]] but not with ex-[[President of Italy|President]] [[Silvio Berlusconi]]’s [[Forza Italia]] party. [https://www.politico.eu/article/italy-luigi-di-maio-rules-out-coalition-with-silvio-berlusconi-5star-movement-forza-italia/ (Politco)]
*[[Egyptian presidential election, 2018]], [[Censorship in Egypt]]
**[[Egypt]]ian news site ''Masr al-Arabia'' says its offices were raided and a journalist arrested in response to them republishing a ''[[New York Times]]'' article alleging irregularities in the nation's recent Presidential election. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/apr/04/egyptian-website-editor-arrested-for-republishing-article-on-election (The Guardian)]
